name: nonroot
evidence: Docker conformance probe (2026-11-19): one disposable container from the image above (network none, all capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, 512 MiB, 1 CPU, 256 pids), removed afterwards.
getent passwd nonroot -> nonroot:x:1000:1000:dog,,,:/home/nonroot:/bin/bash; id nonroot -> uid=1000(nonroot) gid=1000(nonroot) groups=1000(nonroot); no group lists nonroot as a member.

The shell /bin/bash is executable and listed in /etc/shells. `docker exec -u nonroot`, `-u 1000:1000` and `-u 1000` each select the account (id printed uid=1000(nonroot) gid=1000(nonroot) for all three); HOME=/home/nonroot was observed for `-u nonroot` and `-u 1000:1000` only, and was not separately recorded for `-u 1000`. `su nonroot` fails under dropped capabilities and is never used.
/opt/miniconda3/bin/python (symlink to python3.11) exists, is executable by nonroot and runs Python 3.11.5; `-I -c` works and imports hashlib, json, os, stat, sys.

/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/bin/python (symlink to python3.9) exists, is executable by nonroot and runs Python 3.9.20; `-I -c` works. It remains the task's interpreter and is not used for verification.
uid 1001 has no passwd entry in this image; a uid without an entry gets HOME=/ from Docker, so a bare numeric uid is not sufficient.
still_unverified: Claude Code (no node, npm or claude binary is present in the image; its libraries and behaviour as this account are untested)
tmpfs uid/gid/mode options as echoed by docker inspect, and tar extraction as this account into a tmpfs
running with a read-only root filesystem and HOME on a tmpfs (the Rosetta translator writes $HOME/.cache/rosetta on first use)
exec stdin half-close and the quiesce behaviour (kill -KILL -1 as this account)
the per-run identity probe (IDENTITY_SCRIPT) is the run-time re-check of these values and remains mandatory
